variants.headline: Home world sends punitive expedition
variants.sub: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has sent a punitive expedition. Dispatch and arrival are different events, and this report establishes only the former. Readers considering {target} should not be asked to accept an invented landing, confrontation or account of force as part of the news of its departure.

Dispatch of an expedition is not a complete account of conditions in the colony. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: An expedition with a punitive purpose
variants.sub: The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony.
variants.body:
A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world. Its stated purpose makes the action a serious question of authority and responsibility. For {target}, scrutiny should begin with the dispatch itself, without supplying a route, a timetable or a result that the report does not establish.

Dispatch of an expedition is not a complete account of conditions in the colony. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: Distant authority dispatches an expedition
variants.sub: The home world has sent a punitive expedition.
variants.body:
The relationship with the home world now includes the dispatch of an expedition intended to punish the colony. That is a substantial political event on its own. An assessment of {target} should preserve the distinction between what has been sent and what has actually happened in {colony}.

Dispatch of an expedition is not a complete account of conditions in the colony. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
